notes: Wallpaper read, diversified. Your Native check line showed the single wallpaper read was failing before it returned anything, so 0.7.4 tries four independent system paths in sequence - the Android 14 system-drawable read, the classic read, the fast preview read (which returns a live wallpaper's preview on many devices), and decoding the wallpaper file directly - each isolated so one failure cannot block the others. The Native check line in Appearance > Background now also shows a 'Read trail' naming which path delivered the image, or the exact failure each one hit, plus whether a live wallpaper is set. Everything else is unchanged from 0.7.3.
